blocks.text: CEBU CITY, Philippines — A mother’s desperate attempt to locate her missing teenage daughter led law enforcement officers to break into a high-rise residential condominium in Barangay Kamputhaw, Cebu City, on Wednesday morning, where they rescued nine women held against their will, including a 15-year-old minor. The operation resulted in the arrest of a 59-year-old American national identified by authorities as “Jonathan,” a retired investor from Missouri, USA, who was residing in the rented unit along Juana Osmeña Extension.
